caption: The drawing depicts a long-sleeved, full-length dress with a fitted bodice and a wide, voluminous skirt. The dress is cream or light beige in color with vertical stripes of floral patterns in shades of pink, red, green, and blue. The bodice features a draped neckline and is detailed with diagonal bands that match the striped floral trim. The sleeves are large and puffed, narrowing at the wrist with lace cuffs. The fabric of the dress is decorated uniformly with repeated small motifs between the vertical floral stripes. The drawing is rendered on a plain, light background, and there are no visible accessories or additional objects besides the dress itself. The dress appears headless and armless as it is only the garment depicted, not worn by a figure.
title: Woman's Dress
